features.title: Project Skeleton with FastAPI/React and Core Build Workflow
acceptance: FastAPI backend runs with health endpoint
React frontend builds and serves dashboard
Docker Compose starts backend, frontend, and Keycloak
Backend lists SwiftPM projects from workspace directory
Frontend displays project list with build status
Backend tests pass (pytest)
Frontend typecheck and tests pass (npm run build, npm test)

features.title: Scan Workspace Added/Updated Tracking
acceptance: Scan endpoint returns accurate added/updated project counts
Service tracks whether each discovered project is new or updated
Tests verify added/updated counts
Scan response includes added_projects and updated_projects lists with project names
Scan endpoint uses BackgroundTasks for better responsiveness
Targets and dependencies parsing handles both legacy and new formats

features.title: SwiftPM Build Orchestration
acceptance: Backend can trigger `swift build` for a selected project
Build logs streamed to frontend via SSE/WebSocket
Build artifacts (binary, .app bundle) listed after success
Cross-compilation target selection (device/simulator)

features.title: iOS Device Connection and Deployment
acceptance: Backend detects connected iOS devices via usbmuxd/ideviceinstaller
Frontend shows device list with connection status
Deploy .app bundle to selected device
Address 'stuck on Connecting' with proper logging/timeout handling

features.title: Darwin SDK Installation and Status
acceptance: Backend can download/install Darwin SDK from Apple
SDK status endpoint shows installed versions
Frontend SDK manager with install/remove actions

features.title: Apple Developer Authentication
acceptance: OIDC login with Keycloak (configured for Apple ID broker)
2FA handling with proper timeout/fallback
App Store Connect API token management
Capability registration (WeatherKit, etc.)

features.title: Xcode Project Import/Conversion
acceptance: Parse .xcodeproj/.xcworkspace files
Convert to SwiftPM Package.swift
Preserve targets, schemes, build settings

features.title: iOS Simulator on Linux/Windows
acceptance: Research feasibility document
QEMU/KVM-based approach or remote macOS runner integration
Proof-of-concept for headless simulator
